platform: HP Z220, Windows 10 Pro build 19045, 8 GiB RAM

failedClientDisposalAttempt.cause: StreamWriter disposal attempted a second flush after a successfully acknowledged peer had closed. Replaced the test request with one explicit UTF-8 pipe write.

checks.Description: Crash occurs beyond the fixture's distinctive four-second opening.
Independent listener hears the opening tone after a hard kill, rather than checkpoint-position tail audio.
Actual repeated audio is recorded as a new attempt linked to the interrupted attempt.
Skip admission is acknowledged before hard kill.
A lost-response Skip retry is accepted after host restart.
The consumed item stays consumed and a duplicate Skip cannot skip the next song.
One durable Skip produces exactly one terminal Skip despite process death and retry.
The already skipped song is not started a third time.
Recovery and restarted attempts preserve the complete event hash chain.
An explicitly stopped station stays stopped after host restart, while the command interface remains available.
Command IDs retain their original operation after restart; a rejected Stop cannot terminate the host.
Control interface remains responsive after a cross-operation receipt collision.
Listener endpoint confirms that the stopped station did not silently autostart.

note: Real isolated one-station AAC hard-kill/restart and durable stop-intent checks. These do not qualify the complete product or production migration.
